scope: Independent read-only plan attack; no tests, browser, dispatch, git or tracked edits performed.
proposed_unit: Enable existing MATRX_STARTUP_INTERVAL_DIAGNOSTIC for settings-controls in hosted workflow acceptance step.

coverage.owned_unowned_interval_accounting: Useful bounded discriminator for observed persistent processes only. Cannot identify renderer or Theme callback, exact host causal shares, or all ephemeral CPU work.
coverage.guard_decisions: Same cpuBusyFraction output feeds reasons and cpu.observe; diagnostic adds awaited work around sample so timing is not identical.
coverage.normal_evidence: Original workflow uploads completed and pending raw journals; normal sanitized copy accepts validated bracket then deliberately drops it.
coverage.normal_admission: Exact reviewed workflow hash and artifact/source checks remain mandatory.
coverage.cost: Existing dispatch, runner and cadence suffice; added ps and journal I/O are nonzero runtime overhead, no new dispatch authorized.

blocking.finding: Flag is shared by guard and child observers, so one-line mapping is not only the proposed per-watch guard bracket and violates a literal no-new-timer-path scope.
blocking.impact: Enables awaited startup process snapshots, recurring timer, boundary filesystem snapshots and an independent HTTP websocket-upgrade probe after connector ownership verification. Existing connector deadline remains configured identically, but observed execution and timing change.
blocking.remedy: Do not implement current smallest-unit framing. Either explicitly rescope and review all existing flag effects with fail-capable callsite tests, or separately propose isolating the guard-only flag; isolation is a new plan requiring attack.

blocking.finding: One workflow edit invalidates exact reviewed workflow admission hash.
blocking.impact: Normal plan/dispatch/verify refuses HOSTED_WORKFLOW_BLOB_UNREVIEWED until new exact bytes are independently reviewed and hash advanced.
blocking.remedy: Include reviewed digest update and normal refusal-positive coverage in concrete unit; never direct dispatch or relax gate.

blocking.finding: Normal copied resource journals intentionally remove interval brackets; a certificate alone cannot retain this discriminator.
blocking.impact: A normally valid certificate may coexist with no retained interval detail in sanitized published journal.
blocking.remedy: Retain original official archive/journal hashes privately and separately preserve privacy-safe diagnostic evidence with original provenance. Do not change normal copier merely to make bracket visible.

advisory.finding: Bracket adds two awaited ps snapshots per guarded sample; guard uses wall-time confirmation expiry. Policy and iostat invocation do not change, but extra work can move observations relative to expiry.
advisory.remedy: Describe instrumentation impact honestly; do not assert unchanged timing. Test identical measurement inputs and explicit timestamps for same guard classification, and diagnostic failures remaining nonfatal.

advisory.finding: Process bracket is not exhaustive attribution. Matching is by PID, executable basename and nondecreasing CPU count; ownership requires descendant membership in both snapshots. Reparenting, new/exited tasks and same-name PID reuse prevent exact interval/causal assignment.
advisory.remedy: Keep evidence limitation and unavailable/new/exited classes explicit; never infer extension renderer from Chromium Helper or host service role from executable alone.

advisory.finding: Existing public-free-runner statement does not mean zero instrumentation runtime. Cost entry currently retains historical list-price weekly numbers alongside public billed-zero basis.
advisory.remedy: Before workflow mutation annotate existing entry incremental work, no added trigger/job/dispatch and unchanged runner, actual public billed cost zero; run cost validator through admitted route.

required_future_checks: Evaluate actual workflow Settings expression and actual forwarded child env; mutation removing only settings-controls branch must fail named assertion. Existing SEO/Chat positives and unrelated-case negatives stay covered.

Exercise actual existing child flag callsites and prove expected enabled/disabled startup snapshot, timer/probe observation effects under revised scope. Merely checking unchanged MATRX_CDP_STARTUP_DIAGNOSTIC=0 does not prove CDP observer disabled.

Prove guard values and decisions use original iostat output under flag on/off and ps failure; preserve policy, thresholds, source safety boundaries, timers and runner under agreed scope. Same timestamp/input replay proves state machine invariance, not identical physical sample timing.
Keep copy tests accepting then omitting safe bracket and rejecting unsafe fields; confirm raw archive member retention and normal verifier resource finals still required.
Normal workflow contract must reject unreviewed changed bytes and accept only exact newly reviewed digest; exact artifact provenance/source and runner admission tests continue to pass.
no_product_credit: Retained Settings9a remains resource-invalid with all19 cases zero new credit; no product patch, retry, release, runner relocation or role attribution justified.
recommendation: Root should retain this bounded plan without implementation until shared child-observer effects are explicitly scoped. Existing guard bracket is useful only for observed-process interval ownership accounting; it cannot answer renderer/callback cause.
owner_decision: REVISE accepted. One-line shared-flag change is not implemented. Future scoped guard-only or fully declared observer design requires a fresh plan attack, fail-capable source checks, independent exact workflow digest review and fresh normal admission. No native retry, workflow/guard/app change or dispatch from this proposal.
